verdict.rationale: The xAI API covers the core generative surface the UI offers: text chat with streaming, reasoning and structured outputs, image understanding, generation and multi-image editing, and text-, image- and reference-to-video plus video editing. Speech-to-text and multi-agent research are also exposed, and a public OpenAPI spec exists. However, many consumer and business UI features are documented only as in-chat or web-app capabilities, with no evidence of API equivalents: built-in OAuth connectors (Gmail, Drive, Teams, Salesforce), Grok Bot's persistent cloud computer, conversation sharing, workspace and member management, SSO, and billing. Missing for 10: API access to built-in connectors, Grok Bot, conversation history and sharing, workspace/admin/billing management, and any explicit parity statement or independent corroboration.
